mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, we are seeing a pleasant 64 degrees under clear skies, providing a crisp start for anyone heading out to the Military Ridge State Trail.

The City of Verona is highlighting its cemetery management services, where residents and non-residents alike can apply for plots, while also offering rebates for rain barrel installations to help with local stormwater conservation.
We have plenty of activities to look forward to, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the farmers market tomorrow and a concert in the park this Thursday.
During the early morning hours of Thursday, an officer performed a traffic stop and arrested the driver for operating while intoxicated, as well as citing them for suspended vehicle registration.
You can look forward to a tasty treat today with butter pecan as our flavor of the day. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so stop by later today for a scoop.
